Competency Description: Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments;
Skill Indicators: Follows through on commitments and makes sure others do the same; Acts with a clear sense of ownership; Takes personal responsibility for decisions, actions, and failures; Establishes clear responsibilities and processes for monitoring work and measuring results; Designs feedback loops into work
Overused Skill: May not give appropriate credit to others; Strictly enforces accountability;Doesn't consider situation that are beyond individuals control; Focuses too much on numbers and hard data, measurement becomes a goal and a pursuit of it's own
Less Skilled: Fails to accept a fair share of personal responsibility; Gathers little information about how things are going; Provides inadequate feedback, fails to help others adjust course midstream; Prefers to be one of many accountable for an assignment

Competency Description: Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with urgency, energy, enthusiasm;
Skill Indicators: Takes action without unnecessary planning; Seizes new opportunities; Displays can-do attitude; Handles tough issues
Overused Skill: Pushes solutions before adequate analysis; May waste energy by immediatley tackling an issue, forcing rework along the way; Is so ready to act alone, misses counsel from others
Less Skilled: Is slow to act on an opportunity; Spends too much time planning and looking for information; May be overly methodical, taking too long to act on a problem; Is reluctant to step-up to challenges, waits for someone else to take action

Competency Description: Operating effectively amid uncertainty;
Skill Indicators: Deals with uncertainty; Handles risk; Acts without full picture; Stays calm/productive; Works with unclear problems
Overused Skill: Moves to conclusions/action without enough data; Errs toward new/risky over proven solutions; Doesn't honor others' need for clarity;
Less Skilled: Struggles with ambiguous situations; Delays moving forward until all details known; Appears stressed when uncertain; Operates best when structured/predictable;

Competency Description: Attracting and selecting best talent for current/future needs;
Skill Indicators: Finds talent; Selects diverse talent; Closes talent gaps; Good judge of talent
Overused Skill: Overanalyzes and fails to get people into roles quickly; May overlook slow starters and quiet talent;
Less Skilled: Haphazardly selects talent; Takes little action to match talent to role; Unclear about selection criteria; Selects people similar to self;

Competency Description: Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization's goals;
Skill Indicators: Knows how businesses work and how organizations make money; Keeps up with current and possible future policies, practices, and trends in the organization, with the competition, and in the marketplace; Uses knowledge of business drivers and how strategies and tactics play out in the market to guide actions
Overused Skill: Overdevelops/depends on industry/business knowledge at expense of personal/interpersonal/managerial/leadership skills;
Less Skilled: Doesn't understand how businesses work; Not up-to-date on policies/trends; Unaware of strategies/tactics in marketplace; Doesn't take business drivers into account;

Competency Description: Building partnerships and working collaboratively;
Skill Indicators: Works cooperatively; Partners with others; Credits contributions; Gains trust
Overused Skill: Overly consensus-driven, struggles to make timely decisions; Risks being perceived as lacking courage; Too accommodating; Prioritizes collaboration over tough decisions;
Less Skilled: Overlooks opportunities to work collaboratively; Values own interests above others; Shuts down communication across groups; Prefers to work alone;

Competency Description: Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences;
Skill Indicators: Is effective in a variety of communication settings; Attentively listens to others; Adjusts to fit the audience and the message; Provides timely and helpful information to others across the organization; Encourages the open expression of diverse ideas and opinions
Overused Skill: May overinform, giving out information that isn't helpful or harms productivity; May try to win with style and communication skills over fact and substance; May invest too much time crafting communications
Less Skilled: Has difficulty communicating clear written and verbal messages; Tends to always communicate the same way without adjusting to diverse audiences; Doesn't take the time to listen or understand others viewpoints; Doesn't consistently share information others need to do their jobs

Competency Description: Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems;
Skill Indicators: Asks the right questions to accurately analyze situations; Acquires data from multiple and diverse sources when solving problems; Uncovers root causes to difficult problems; Evaluates pros and cons, risks and benefits of different solution options
Overused Skill: May find it difficult to move forward; May wait too long to come to a conclusion; May get caught up in the process and miss the big picture; May make things more complex than needed
Less Skilled: Misses the complexity of issues and force fits solutions; Doesn't gather sufficient information to assess situations completely; Relies solely on intution, even when contrary information exists; Is caught off guard when problems surface without an obvious solution;

Competency Description: Handling conflict situations effectively;
Skill Indicators: Addresses conflicts; Works out agreements; Facilitates breakthroughs; Settles differences
Overused Skill: May be seen as meddling; Too eager to engage in debate; Pushes for resolution before others are ready;
Less Skilled: Avoids conflict; Struggles to make progress through disagreements; Takes sides without understanding issues; Allows conflicts to cause disruption; Puts people on defensive; Accommodates too much;

Competency Description: Stepping up to address difficult issues;
Skill Indicators: Tackles tough assignments; Faces issues; Provides feedback; Champions ideas
Overused Skill: Struggles to identify which battles to take on and when to back down; Shares point of view on everything and could be seen as intimidating or a "know-it-all"; Communicates bluntly and fails to recognize the impacts on relationships with others; Neglects own work in favor of getting involved in multiple difficult issues
Less Skilled: Shies away from difficult issues or challenging assignments; Expresses point of view in an indirect manner; Avoids giving corrective feedback

Competency Description: Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions;
Skill Indicators: Gains insight into customer needs; Identifies opportunities that benefit the customer; Builds and delivers solutions that meet customer expectations; Establishes and maintains effective customer relationships
Overused Skill: Prioritizes information about customers over the important business realities; In the effort to satisfy customers, takes liberties with the organizations policies and procedures; Becomes too close to customers, makes promises to customers that the organization is unable to keep;
Less Skilled: Is unaware of customer expectations; Acts on incomplete or inaccurate understanding of customer needs; Conducts work activies from an internal, operational standpoint; Fails to build effective relationships with key customers

Competency Description: Making good and timely decisions;
Skill Indicators: Makes sound decisions; Uses judgment; Considers factors; Recognizes quick solutions
Overused Skill: Applies overly rigorous decision process to all issues; Overconfident in own decision-making; Reluctant to delegate/involve others
Less Skilled: Approaches decisions haphazardly/delays; Makes decisions on incomplete data; Ignores different points of view; Makes decisions impacting short-term at expense of long-term;

Competency Description: Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization's goals;
Skill Indicators: Places a high priority on developing others; Develops others through coaching, feedback, exposure, and stretch assignments; Aligns employee career development goals with organizational objectives; Encourages people to accept developmental moves
Overused Skill: Concentrates on the development of a few at the expense of many; Overestimates people capcity for growth; may be too quick to adopt faddish development approaches
Less Skilled: Doesn't take time to work on development of others; Is a check-the-box developer, goes with the easiest option to fulfill talent development obligations; Doesn't make use of available organization resourcdes and systems to develop others; Has difficulty identifying developmental moves or assignments;

Competency Description: Recognizing value of diverse perspectives;
Skill Indicators: Values diversity; Understands perspectives; Applies cultural awareness; Sensitive to norms
Overused Skill: May Prioritize valuing difference over achieving results; May make too many allowances for members of a particular group; Is overly sensitive to different groups when delivering tough messages
Less Skilled: Lacks awareness of other cultures; Treats everybody the same without regard to their differences; expects everyone to adapt to their way of thinking and communicating; Lacks curiosity and interest in different people's backgrounds and perspectives

Competency Description: Providing direction, delegating, and removing obstacles to get work done;
Skill Indicators: Provides clear direction and accountabilities; Delegates and distributes assignments and decisions appropriately; Monitors progress by maintaining dialogue on work and results; Provides appropriate guidance and direction based on people's capabilities; Intervenes as needed to remove obstacles
Overused Skill: May be overly directive and stifle creativity and initiative; Pushes people too hard by asking them to work at their upper limits; May overdelegate without providing enough direction or help; Gives people authority that they shouldn't have;
Less Skilled: Provides work to people without giving them sufficient guidance; Sets goals and objectives so easy to achieve that people are demotivated in the process; Saves high-profile tasks for self;

Competency Description: Creating a climate where people are motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives;
Skill Indicators: Structures the work so it aligns with people's goals and motivators; Empowers others; Makes each person feel their contributions are important; Invites input and shares ownership and visibility; Shows a clear connection between people's motivators and organizational goals
Overused Skill: Accommodates others' motivators at expense of needed work; Empowers beyond capacity; Avoids giving constructive feedback if it could impact engagement;
Less Skilled: Little insight into what motivates others; Doesn't give flexibility/autonomy; Does little to create enthusiasm; Unwilling to share ownership/give up control;

Competency Description: Interpreting financial indicators to make decisions;
Skill Indicators: Understands indicators; Applies financial analysis; Integrates info
Overused Skill: Uses financial indicators as only decision criteria, leading to unbalanced view; May sacrifice long-term objectives for short-term gains;
Less Skilled: Unfamiliar with financial terms; Unclear about cause-effect among business functions; Pays little attention to financial impact;

Competency Description: Taking a broad view of issues using a global lens;
Skill Indicators: Broad view; Thinks/talks globally; Understands global context; Aware of global trends
Overused Skill: Tends to overreach or call upon experience that doesn't apply; Minimizes local needs, overemphasizes global issues; Pushes for global opportunities organization isn't prepared for;
Less Skilled: Narrow thinking when solving problems; Seldom offers multiple options/scenarios for global issues; Maintains local-only perspective; Little interest in future of global issues;

Competency Description: Creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful;
Skill Indicators: Comes up with useful ideas that are new, better, or unique; Introduces new ways of looking at problems; Can take a creative idea and put it into practice; Encourages diverse thinking to promote and nurture innovation
Overused Skill: Gravitates toward the new and rejects the old; Comes up with so many unusual ideas that it overwhelms others; Expends too much time and effort looking at creative alternatives instead of taking actions; Relentlessly pursues change and innovation at the cost of efficiency and reliability
Less Skilled: Stays within comfort zone rather than experimenting with new ways of looking at things; Presents ideas that are ordinary, conventional, and from the past; Tends to be critical of others original ideas; Has a style that discourages the creative intitiatives of others;

Competency Description: Relating openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people;
Skill Indicators: Relates well across groups; Diplomatic/tactful; Builds rapport; Builds relationships; Picks up dynamics
Overused Skill: Focused on understanding group/interpersonal dynamics at expense of results; Makes ineffective decisions due to need to be liked; May lack authenticity
Less Skilled: Builds few relationships; Engages only with immediate work area; Uncomfortable with people different from self; Blunt or insensitive; Shows little interest in others' needs;

Competency Description: Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks;
Skill Indicators: Builds strong networks; Maintains relationships; Uses relationships for ideas/resources
Overused Skill: Relies on networking at expense of other skills/work priorities; May be perceived as one-sided networker;
Less Skilled: Builds limited relationships with different groups; Difficulty determining who to contact; Doesn't tap into networks beyond immediate area;

Competency Description: Actively learning through experimentation;
Skill Indicators: Learns quickly; Experiments; Takes unfamiliar tasks; Learns from failures
Overused Skill: Takes on new challenges for sake of it; Focuses on unvetted ideas; May take unnecessary risks in name of learning;
Less Skilled: Struggles to learn in new situations; Frustrated/confused by unfamiliar tasks; Gives up on new ideas too soon; Resists untested solutions;

Competency Description: Navigating complex organizational dynamics;
Skill Indicators: Understands org functioning; Anticipates land mines; Deals with politics; Navigates influence/authority
Overused Skill: May prioritize organizatonal positioning, evening when straightforward action is called for; May be seen as excessively political; May tell others what they want to hear to keep them happy
Less Skilled: Overlooks or disregards the political complexities of the organization; Pursues own areas goals without considering the impact on other groups; Says and does things that strain organizational relationships; Tends to be impatient with organizational processes and makes political errors;

Competency Description: Using compelling arguments to gain the support and commitment of others;
Skill Indicators: Positions views and arguments appropriately to win support; Convinces others to take action; Negotiates skillfully in tough situations; Wins concessions without damaging relationships; Responds effectively to the reactions and positions of others
Overused Skill: Attempts to negotiate when the situation calls for tough and decisive action; Spends so much time persuading that timely results are missed; May come across as manipulative
Less Skilled: Pushes own point of view too strongly; Fails to win support or buy-in from others; Is unable to negotiate solutions that are agreeable to all; Responds negatively to the reactions and position of others; Has difficulty articulating a logical argument that support own position;

Competency Description: Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments;
Skill Indicators: Sets objectives; Breaks down goals; Stages activities; Plans for contingencies
Overused Skill: Is so focused on completing only mission-critical tasks that they let the trivial many accumulate into a critical problem; Persistently follows plans, allowing little room for change; May leave out the human element of the work; Spends an inordinate amount of time planning for unlikely obstacles or roadblocks
Less Skilled: Gets caught up in immediate needs without attending to larger priorities; Spends time and resources without clear purpose; Gets caught off guard by problems due to the lack of contingency plans; Haphazardly tracks progress or performances

Competency Description: Rebounding from setbacks and adversity when facing difficult situations;
Skill Indicators: Is confident under pressure; Handles and manages crises effectively; Maintains a positive attitude despite adversity; Bounces back from setbacks; Grows from hardships and negative experiences
Overused Skill: Unreasonably confident/optimistic, misses signs of trouble; Fails to show emotion, comes across as cold; Allows stress to pile up; Minimizes severity of situation;
Less Skilled: Gets easily rattled in high-pressure; Low energy/motivation during stress; Acts defensively with criticism; Takes too long to recover from setbacks;

Competency Description: Securing and deploying resources effectively;
Skill Indicators: Marshals resources; Orchestrates activities; Maximizes resources; Applies knowledge
Overused Skill: Stretches resources beyond capacity; Hoards resources; Gathers resources too far ahead or obtains excess; Diverts too quickly from plan when unexpected happens;
Less Skilled: Difficulty figuring out where to get resources; Relies on same resources; Gets frustrated/inefficient when things don't go as planned; Imposes one way of doing things;

Competency Description: Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances;
Skill Indicators: Has a strong bottom-line orientation; Persists in accomplishing objectives despite obstacles and setbacks; Has a track record of exceeding goals successfully; Pushes self and helps others achieve results
Overused Skill: Goes for results at all costs without appropriate concern for people, teams, due process, or possibly norms and ethics; May be so deadline orientedthat they push to get something done rather than taking the time to do it right;Even in the face of near insurmountable obstacles, sticks with the effort beyond reason; Puts too much pressure on self and others to achieve the impossible; May not celebrate and share successes;
Less Skilled: Is reluctant to push for results; Does the least to get by; Is an inconsistent performer; Gives up easily, doesn’t go back with different strategies for the third and fourth try; Often misses deadlines; Procrastinates around whatever gets in the way

Competency Description: Using feedback and reflection to gain insight;
Skill Indicators: Reflects on impact; Seeks feedback; Open to criticism; Admits mistakes; Knows strengths/weaknesses
Overused Skill: Overthinks/overanalyzes feedback; May be self-critical to point of risking credibility; Spends too much time on self-insight, not enough on meaningful change;
Less Skilled: Doesn't reflect on past mistakes; Acts defensively when given feedback; Unaware of own skills/interpersonal impact; Makes excuses/blames others;

Competency Description: Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels;
Skill Indicators: Shows personal commitment and takes action to continuously improve; Accepts assignments that broaden capabilities; Learns from new experiences, from others, and from structured learning; Makes the most of available development resources
Overused Skill: Develops for sake of development, without focus/objective; Focuses on own development at expense of obligations; Susceptible to self-help fads;
Less Skilled: Doesn't put in effort to grow/change; Comfortable with current skills; Fearful of mistakes; Lacks awareness/interest in developmental resources;

Competency Description: Adapting behavior to match demands;
Skill Indicators: Reads cues; Adapts approach; Understands different approaches; Acts accordingly
Overused Skill: May be seen as social chameleon; Hypervigilant in monitoring dynamics, comes across as indecisive/wavering;
Less Skilled: Uses same style regardless of situation; Fails to notice changing demands; Expects others to adjust to their style; Thinks being true to self is all that matters; Doesn't understand dynamics;

Competency Description: Anticipating and balancing needs of multiple stakeholders;
Skill Indicators: Understands stakeholder needs; Balances interests; Considers cultural/ethical factors; Acts fairly
Overused Skill: Spends too much time interacting with stakeholders, slowing decision making; Too focused on clarifying needs/building consensus;
Less Skilled: Focuses on meeting expectations of limited stakeholders; Considers some interests more strongly; Allows conflicting demands to unfairly influence actions

Competency Description: Seeing ahead to future possibilities and creating strategies;
Skill Indicators: Anticipates trends; Scenarios; Articulates visions; Creates strategies
Overused Skill: May be seen as too theoretical; So far ahead others have trouble seeing path; Impatient with tactical issues; Overcomplicates plans;
Less Skilled: Comfortable in tactical here and now; Spends little time on strategic issues; Contributes little to strategic discussions; Lacks disciplined thought processes;

Competency Description: Building strong-identity teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals;
Skill Indicators: Forms teams with diverse mix; Establishes common objectives; Creates belonging & morale; Shares wins & rewards; Fosters open dialogue & collaboration
Overused Skill: May focus so much on teaming behavior that results may suffer;May build such a strong sense of team identity that it is hard for new members to break in and get up to speed; May not develop individual leaders
Less Skilled: Doesn’t create a common mindset or challenge; Fails to recognizxe4 that morale, recognition and belongingness are integral ingredients of effective teams; Doesn't shape and distribute assignments in a way that encourages teamwork

Competency Description: Anticipating and adopting innovations in business-building digital and technology applications;
Skill Indicators: Anticipates emerging technologies; Scans for new skills/knowledge; Rejects low-impact/fad tech; Learns/adopts new tech
Overused Skill: Focuses too much on learning new technology or exploring applications rather than applying it to business goals; Overlooks when others may not have the same level of tech savvy;
Less Skilled: Is inexperienced with key technology tools or too comfortable with existing applications to adopt new tech; Fails to seek out new or innovative technologies that could add business value;

Competency Description: Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity;
Skill Indicators: Follows through on commitments; Is seen as direct and truthful; Keeps confidences; Practices what they preach; Shows consistency between words and actions
Overused Skill: May push openess and honesty to the point of being disruptive;May come across as overly judgemental of those not quite as overtly authentic
Less Skilled: Lacks consistent follow-through on commitments; Betrays confidence and covers up mistakes; Mirepresents facts for personal gain; makes promises but doesn't always keep them

Competency Description: Painting a compelling picture of vision and strategy to motivate action;
Skill Indicators: Talks about future possibilities; Creates milestones/symbols; Articulates vision; Creates energy/optimism
Overused Skill: May lack follow-through to execute vision; Communicates at high level too often; Lacks patience when others don't share vision/purpose;
Less Skilled: Fails to connect with organization's vision; Difficulty describing vision compellingly; Can't simplify complex strategy; Struggles to energize/build excitement;

Competency Description: Knowing most effective/efficient processes;
Skill Indicators: Identifies processes; Efficient workflow; Designs procedures; Continuous improvement
Overused Skill: Trouble explaining processes; Attempts to put too much together; Oversimplifies; Tinkers with processes that work; Focused on efficiency, leaves out human element;
Less Skilled: Works disorganized; Difficulty figuring out effective/efficient processes; Accepts processes as they are; Doesn't take advantage of synergy/efficiency;
